subject: Jigsaw POC: workshop orchestration & runbook
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@jigsaw.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: jigsaw-sales@jigsaw.ai
Date: 2027-09-28T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff & hands-on workshop for Jigsaw POC

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Jigsaw is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to book a 2.5 hour working session that covers:
- Prompt review and expected outputs
- Routing / fallback behavior for our multitenant flows
- One controlled load test to validate latency under burst (approx 10k reqs/hour)

Availability this week: Wed (10/6) or Fri (10/8) in the afternoon PST. If those don't work we can push to the following week.

Also: can you send a runbook and sample prompts ahead of time so our engineering lead can prep?

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Platforms, Jigsaw AI

[attachment: jigsaw-initial-requirements.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@jigsaw.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff & hands-on workshop for Jigsaw POC

Hi Liam — great to hear. We can definitely run the 2.5 hr hands-on session. Proposed agenda:
1) 15m intros & objectives
2) 45m prompt walkthrough + prompt set mapping (bring sample prompts)
3) 40m routing workshop (policy definitions, fallbacks, metrics to capture)
4) 30m controlled load validation (short bursts + steady-state)
5) 20m actions & next steps

Suggested slots (PST):
- Thu 10/7 13:00–15:30
- Mon 10/11 14:00–16:30

I've attached a living runbook (poc-runbook.pdf) and a CSV with suggested prompts. Ben, Dev — can you review the loadtest-config and confirm we can run the burst profile (10k/hr) from our Dedicated pool without impacting other tenants?

Attachments: poc-runbook.pdf, sample-prompts.csv

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[attachment: poc-runbook.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff & hands-on workshop for Jigsaw POC

Olga — quick technical note (cc'd Karthik/Dev):
- The burst profile in loadtest-config.yaml is okay but we should gate the 10k/hr as a short burst window (10 minutes) to observe KV cache warmup and latency tail.
- Recommend pre-warming with a lightweight prefix set 20m before the session.
- If Jigsaw wants sustained higher throughput we'll propose a Dedicated config tweak (increase burst capacity) and a follow-up load window.

I'll update loadtest-config.yaml and push it to the Drive link. Dev, can you validate no interference with other scheduled Dedicated jobs on 10/7 and 10/11?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Performance Engineering, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Thu 10/7 is tight for our execs. Mon 10/11 14:00–16:30 PST works better for the engineering team, but can we shift start +2 hours to 16:00–18:30? We want to finish before EOD GMT for our London engineers.

Also two asks for the session:
- Can we spend extra time on prompt tuning for our multi-turn flows (we have a set of 25 prompts).
- Please include a short example of routing rules that prefer smaller, faster models for low-confidence queries.
